name: PC2P2C
author: Xeinth
description: Hold into the top part of the cube portal at 28% to make both icons be on the top side of the gameplay and then keep holding to have both icons be ball. Play through the levels top-half gameplay while using a P1 and P2 input until 59% where you need to land on the right corner of the floating hitboxes and then buffer a jump to enter the cube portal at 60%. Play the level normally from there.
